# DOGEON — Authoritative Recreation Manifest

Derived from source on 2026-11-14. Game code `src/game.js` (loaded by the 18-line `index.html` shell) = **1476 lines**, 18 sections, 50 sim scenarios.

**Forbidden-API check:** ✅ none present (no fetch/alert/confirm/prompt/XHR/import; WebSocket only inside the opt-in MULTIPLAYER section)

**Multiplayer option (D-040):** OFF by default. `?mp=ws(s)://host[:port]&room=NAME&name=NAME` turns on ghost multiplayer over the browser's native WebSocket (no library). Self-host with zero deps: `node server/relay.mjs` (serves the game page + relay; `PORT`, `MAX_ROOM` env). Shared enemies/loot are out of scope (would need an authoritative server, e.g. Colyseus).
